after.offer_match_notes: Match chemical form, hydration, purity, stock concentration and dimensions before cost proration. 2026-10-18: 25×75mm slide dimensions match P27; source does not impose a specific glass composition or thickness. This is purchased substrate count, not a claim that one entire pack is consumed. United MSL3X1: manufacturer catalog page 361 confirms plain 75 × 25 × 1.0–1.2 mm glass, 72 per pack. Three dated dealer pack offers accepted for this line only; reusable-substrate allocation remains unresolved.

No new model profiles requested in bounded task.

rejected_decisions.subject: United Scientific plain microscope slides as silica/sapphire/silicon/ITO/coated-glass substrates
rejected_decisions.reason: Plain sheet glass75x25mm does not establish fused silica, sapphire, doped silicon, thermal oxide or conductive coating identity. No aliases or costing eligibility assigned to these different substrate components.
